frame.name: BodyParts3D raw frame = frame of assets/models/body/skeletal.glb (identity node transforms, no conversion)
frame.note: NOT 'Z-Anatomy based': the whole body is BodyParts3D (Blender glTF export with export_yup=False, i.e. Blender world = glTF axes); the Z-Anatomy layers are warped INTO this frame.

source.body: male (female bones = warped male except pelvis/sacrum: not built)

attributes.COLOR_0: u8 normalized RGBA, LINEAR colour (white-ish base material expected)
attributes._CURV: f32 scalar in -1..1 (+ convex, - concave); three.js GLTFLoader exposes it as geometry.attributes._curv
